title: Days of Yore (Ki Sngi Ba La Leit Noh)
khasi_title: Ki Sngi Ba La Leit Noh
cultural_context: A poignant, nostalgic reflection upon ancestral times and youthful camaraderie. Recalls the peaceful simplicity of village childhood, gatherings around the hearth fire, and venerates the memory of elders who have passed into the ancestral realm.
lyrics_khasi:
Kumno ngan klet ia kito ki sngi,
Ba nga dang ialehkai ha la ka shnong;
Ki sngi ba shai, ki por ba suk,
Haba ka dohnud ka dang lui-lui!

Ki tymmen mynhyndai ki iathuh parom,
Ha rympei dingshan ha ka miet ba daitthah;
La ki sngi ki la leit noh kum ka lyer,
Ka jingkynmaw ia ki kan ym duh lano lano!
lyrics_english:
How can I ever forget those golden days of old,
When I used to play innocently in my native village;
Those bright days, those peaceful times,
When the youthful heart knew only gentle innocence!

The elders of ancient times shared beloved folklore,
Beside the warm hearth on bitterly cold frosty nights;
Though those days have drifted away like the passing mountain wind,
Their sacred memory shall never, ever fade away!

stanzas.title: Ki Sngi Khunlung (Days of Childhood)
stanzas.khasi:
Kumno ngan klet ia kito ki sngi,
Ba nga dang ialehkai ha la ka shnong;
Ki sngi ba shai, ki por ba suk,
Haba ka dohnud ka dang lui-lui!
stanzas.english: How could I forget those golden days when I played in my native village; bright peaceful times when the heart knew only gentle joy!

stanzas.title: Ka Jingkynmaw ha Rympei (Memories by the Hearth)
stanzas.khasi:
Ki tymmen mynhyndai ki iathuh parom,
Ha rympei dingshan ha ka miet ba daitthah;
La ki sngi ki la leit noh kum ka lyer,
Ka jingkynmaw ia ki kan ym duh lano lano!
stanzas.english: Elders told legends by warm hearths on frosty nights; though days have fled like wind, memories will never perish!

vocabulary.sngi ba la leit noh: Days gone by; the cherished ancestral past
vocabulary.daitthah: Biting cold frost on a clear highland winter night
vocabulary.dingshan: Hearth fire stoked with oak and pine logs
